passages.original: Livius electus fregit, captivus, ut aiunt,
passages.english: Livius, chosen [for command], broke [them]; a captive, as they say,
passages.notes: The line is a fragment with no context, so the object of "fregit" and the reference of "captivus" are uncertain. "Livius" may be Marcus Livius Salinator, elected consul against Hasdrubal (Metaurus, 207 BC); the author could not be identified.
